title: Placeholder words under credential-named keys
summary: Assignments such as secret=" changeme" (leading space), secret_key="changeme2" and secret_key: "REDACTED-EXAMPLE", where the key sounds like a credential and the value is placeholder vocabulary in several spellings.
rationale: The key name is a strong signal, so the value has to be looked at. Placeholder words written with a leading space, a trailing digit or as a compound are still placeholders, and treating only exact matches as placeholders flags half of the documentation examples.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. The values are placeholder vocabulary in recognised spellings; nothing in them was issued, and the key name alone is not evidence of a secret.
